metadata.title: ऐसा आदिवासी बाज़ार मैंने पहली बार देखा | A Tribal Market Like Never Before | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In this episode, Main Bhi Bharat travels to the tribal heartland of Nandurbar, Maharashtra, to explore a unique rural economy built around bull rearing and farming.
In local bull markets, small and marginal farmers buy young calves, raise and train them with care, and use them for agricultural work for nearly two years. Once the bulls are fully grown and well-trained, they are sold to bigger farmers in regional markets. This system helps tribal families sustain their livelihoods while keeping traditional, animal-based farming alive.
